request_policy.statuses: Every primary requiresHTTP200; primary404 is failure. Every sidecar permits200or404 only. Retain all responses/partials including404 and explicit failure evidence.
request_policy.canonical_paths: Exclusive canonical nested downloads/<repository-relative-path>[sidecar].partial under fixed output root. No flattening/traversal/overwrite/cache install.
request_policy.sidecars: All four explicitly proposed for every primary including metadata XML. Applicability and availability unobserved. HTTP200 checksum must validate applicable primary; bad strong checksum refuses. HTTP404 optional absence recorded. Signatures are unverified, not publisher authentication.
request_policy.transport: Fixed HTTPS exact URL only; no redirects/retries/fallback/recursivefetch/credential/proxy/netrc/config search.
request_policy.trust: Same-origin consistency only; no independent publisher authentication, executable trust or acquired-code execution.
